notes.title: First Patch Release! (July 2025)
notes.notes: [p]Hi! Thanks to those who bought and tried the game right on release day. Here's the first set of patches:  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Removed the initial flash of graphs in Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the correct answer display inside Solvebit modes (e.g. Time mode) [/p][/*][*][p]Invert "Find trigonometry functions" with "Find quadratic functions" inside Graphbit[/p][/*][*][p]Fix LSD Cats & Secret Number achievement inside game[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I expect to push 1-2 updates each month starting from now, so feel free to leave your suggestions below![/p]
